source_binding: Build ONLY the baseline gateway service binary from exact pinned4b8cb79; build candidate service/probe/fixture targets with identical Rust1.97.1 release settings. Freeze both service executables plus shared probe/fixture generator before traffic; record separate manifests/source SHAs. Do not compile arbitrary historical examples.

topology.underlay: two veth links through one owned IPv4 router namespace
topology.stream_profile: spiralcore-object/1 reliable QUIC; no datagrams; separate from unchanged TUN packet path
topology.routing: Only namespace-local underlay routes and router forwarding; no host route/firewall/NAT changes.
topology.privilege: Service runs as the unprivileged runner UID after namespace entry. Test keys/configs/large fixtures/stores stay in one fresh owned private temporary directory.

dose.persistence: One authenticated connection/receiver/cache per arm/profile/trial; both size groups sequentially. Retain only one size-specific sender codec/prediction at a time. Fresh stores and channel between arms.
dose.warmup: All three native trials retained; no JIT/warmup trial discarded. Fixture generation is outside transfer; codec preparation, file input loading, hashing, schema/checkpoint/seed transfer and durable publication are charged.
dose.auxiliary_operations: Both Combined arms publish checkpoint then schema per tier, then six sends. Whole-zstd sends six without auxiliary publications. No forced target seed. Both tiers share one persistent receiver/channel per arm; stores are fresh between arms.

calibration.reuse: One topology and measured underlay calibration per profile/trial, reused for four arms. Recreate qdiscs before each arm so measurement counters start at zero; save before/after exact state.
calibration.ping: 20 echoes from both sides; final16 mean retained. Shaped mean75..90ms, LAN below20ms;20received required.
calibration.rate: Shaped only: iperf3TCP each direction,3measured seconds after1startup second. Receiver goodput8.5..10.2Mbit/s; fullJSON retained. Calibration traffic outside QUIC captures.
calibration.congestion: 40ms+10mbit netem on each router egress,limit256,no random loss/jitter. Retain/report queue loss; do not reject solely for finite-queue congestion. Require drained queues and valid qdisc configuration.

correctness.fixtures: Generator reuses canonical State::seeded/Recipe/shared_runtime::replay and hashes exact bytes. No runtime kernels duplicated; generated lengths must match fixed tiers. Trial-bound opaque bytes are a control, not decrypted traffic.
correctness.durable: Published must follow verified durable commit. Receiver closes/reopens its endpoint, reads committed IDs, and compares eight expected local data files byte-for-byte. Both repeats reuse existing object IDs and source paths.
correctness.setup: Checkpoint/schema IDs may already exist within one receiver; count actual observed setup transfer, never assumed full payload bytes. Missing bases/checkpoints are errors, no silent hidden reseed.
correctness.winner: Both Combined arms must use RuntimeV1 verified-transfer for generated, SparseV1 verified-transfer for opaque-edited, and Raw verified-cache-hit for repeats. Their residual winner must match each other, without preselecting a mode. Bind all identities/lengths and verify eight expected data files after reopen.
correctness.before_after_parity: Match all16 operations for each profile/trial: group,label,action,input length,object ID,selected mode,publication path,frame/data byte counts,requests,batches and actual request/response logical counter deltas. Selection candidates/pruned may differ. Canonical offer/base/body/frame equality is separately covered by frozen-baseline core tests; existing encrypted network receipts do not expose body hashes.

measurement.capture: One endpoint-a underlay interface, bidirectional classic Ethernet header-only PCAP from before handshake through close/drain. Preserve tcpdump immediate mode and two identical complete captured=received>0/drop0 snapshots within100 polls at100ms; final PCAP/counter equality remains strict. Count original IP/UDP/Ethernet lengths, excluding FCS/preamble/gap.
measurement.cpu: Client operationCPU includes inputload+encoding/hash+publication wait's activeCPU; group prep separately includes replay. Receiver handleCPU includes decode+durablecommit; reopened readback separate. Whole-processCPU separately reported, never added to nested stages.
measurement.wall: Peroperation through Published; group setup, QUIC setup, fullclient/server process and harnesssession wall separately. No logging between operations; no subtraction ofCPU to invent send-only time.
measurement.amortization: Report setup alone; setup+generated and cumulative through2,3,4,5,6delivered objects pergroup, alongside complete two-tier session including authentication/closure.
measurement.statistics: Three descriptive matched trials with a complete three-arm Latin rotation. Current same-run Whole-zstd, pinned Combined-before and candidate Combined-after share fixtures, PKI, Rust toolchain/build flags and runner. No historical timing pooling. Retain negative results.
measurement.acceptance: All264 operations,216 delivered objects, reopened exact data, full captures, calibrated links and source/binary identities valid; six before/after operation parity checks must pass. A speed improvement is measured, not required to hide a valid losing result.

custody.cleanup: Stop/reap only owned processes. Verify public receipt custody and exact reopened objects before deleting owned per-arm stores. Keep failure logs; delete generated private keys/configs/largefixtures only from owned mktemp directory.
custody.retention: New compact evidence in2026-11-02-candidate-cpu. Original ZIPs with both service binaries/captures archived in existing private HF dataset and fresh immutable-download hash verified before owned cleanup.

scope: Cooperating reliable QUIC object channel on one Linux runner, local and shaped80ms/10Mbps profiles; not actual Internet WAN, transparent TUN compression, production/FIPS/CUI or energy qualification.
historical_comparator: Preserve historical Runtime/Combined evidence and analyzer output. This new three-arm comparison replaces separate Runtime/Warm controls with pinned Combined-before; it does not alter historical results.
